selected_direction: First round, cute draft; retain the mascot's soft, friendly proportions. Express punch force through stance, body lean and arm extension rather than redesigning the character.

action.notes: This is an A0 front-view action sample, not approval of the 33-frame Alpha atlas. Back/side samples remain open.

generation.chosen_draft: The first, rounded/cute direction, per project owner instruction on 2026-10-28.
generation.wall_clock_note: Approximate image-generation call time for the three selected frames only; excludes prompt iterations, inspection, integration, QA and any human art effort. It is not a production artist-day estimate.

image_spec.source_art_editing: No crop or paint-over applied. Per-frame foot anchors are retained in metadata for runtime alignment.
image_spec.foot_anchor_method: Approximate horizontal center of the dark-brown foot pixels in the lower body region; vertical anchor is the alpha>=16 lowest visible row. Confirm both in the fixed-camera UE render.

ue_import_recommendation.alpha_usage: Opacity mask; verify masked edge at 720p and 1080p
